I need to find the exact date when a picture of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to the Wikipedia page on the "Principle of double effect". The answer should be in DD/MM/YYYY format.

Please do the following research using websearch and webfetch:

1. Search for: "Principle of double effect" Wikipedia edit history Thomas Aquinas image
2. Fetch the Wikipedia page's edit history: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Principle_of_double_effect&action=history
3. Look through the edit history for any edit that added an image of St. Thomas Aquinas. Search for edits mentioning "Aquinas", "Thomas", "image", "picture", or "file".
4. Also try the Wikipedia API: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&titles=Principle_of_double_effect&prop=revisions&rvlimit=500&rvprop=timestamp|comment|user&format=json
5. You can also try fetching the current page source to see what image is currently displayed, then trace back when it was added.

Be thorough and persistent. The answer is a specific date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
